data_description.disable_rainbird_switches: Each zone's valve replaces its Rain Bird switch, so the switches are disabled to avoid having every zone twice (for example in HomeKit). Turn this off to keep both.
data_description.weather_entity: Pick a weather entity to add a Rain skip switch. Each day at the check time, if today's forecast is wet enough, the controller's rain delay is set.
data_description.rain_chance: Compared with today's precipitation probability. Forecasts without one count as wet when the condition is rainy.
data_description.rain_check_time: Pick a time before your programs start.
data_description.rain_delay_days: Only raised, never shortened, if a longer rain delay is already set.

start_zone.name: Start zone
start_zone.description: Runs a zone once for a set time, without changing its valve runtime.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to run the zone. Rain Bird runs zones in whole minutes.
